'''Paul McCarragher''' is a Star Wars CCG player. They finished 8th in [[DecipherCon 1999 Progressive Sealed Deck]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]<ref name="dc99sw22_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Progressive Sealed Deck], Decipher.
